themes.description: Users report frequent freezes, sluggish performance, confusing interface, missing real-time data, and overall dissatisfaction with the app’s visual design.
themes.business_impact: Loss of user trust leading to higher churn and negative word‑of‑mouth, potential revenue decline from abandoned trades, and increased support costs from crash‑related complaints.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: The latest upgrade introduced regressions in rendering and networking layers, removing critical optimizations for live market data and introducing UI components that are not well‑tested for low‑bandwidth or 5G environments.
themes.action_plan:
• Rollback to the last stable release
• Conduct a full performance profiling of UI and network paths
• Re‑integrate live data feeds from CBOE and other exchanges
• Redesign UI components with responsive, lightweight frameworks
• Implement automated UI/UX regression tests
• Enable real‑time monitoring for freeze events and crash analytics
• Communicate rollback and future release plan to users

themes.description: Users report that the 1‑day change metric, previously available for all broker holdings, has been restricted to INDmoney‑held shares only, causing loss of cross‑broker portfolio visibility and confusion over total gains/losses.
themes.business_impact: Power users who rely on a single‑tap summary of portfolio performance across multiple brokers lose critical insight, increasing support queries, decreasing confidence in the app, and potentially accelerating churn for advanced investors.
themes.root_cause_hypothesis: A recent scope change aimed at reducing API calls or simplifying UI inadvertently removed the cross‑broker aggregation logic, possibly due to incomplete rollback or oversight during the last release cycle.
themes.action_plan:
• Re‑implement cross‑broker 1‑day change aggregation
• Verify broker API data access and refresh strategy
• Update UI to display total INR gain/loss alongside % change
• Add release notes and rollback fallback
• Monitor usage and support tickets post‑deployment
